given.note: S1-10: Rosie sent Sam the secure ID check link in his own chat ('Open secure page: rosfield.com/v/s01'; the code here is a placeholder). He opens it in a browser with no session. Opening a link proves nothing about who is at the browser (FS line 701; S13-45), so the page acts for no one: it shows what it is for and the business's public name, never Sam's name or anything on file, and offers the sign-in for the link's own account, both ways, so it hints at nothing on file. The link's 7-day life is an example (README open gaps).
